statement_blocker: The inspected 1903 source fixes an everywhere-continuous real 2*pi-periodic function, symmetric sine/cosine partial sums, n-term arithmetic means through s_(n-1), and uniform convergence. Before a root can be frozen, independent review must accept the catalog-to-source identity, definitions, proof boundary, translation and errata, and statement work must choose the source-literal form or checked transports for a circle carrier, arbitrary period, complex scalars, Fourier normalization, indexing, binders, and boundary cases.

canonical_formal_target.candidate_expression: For every continuous real 2*pi-periodic function, the n-term arithmetic means of its first n symmetric Fourier partial sums converge uniformly to the function; a binder-complete Lean encoding and all transports remain open.
canonical_formal_target.candidate_relationship: The first six names are statement substrate. The last two are stronger-premise convergence results and cannot close the unrestricted Fejer root. No candidate is an accepted target or proof.

domain_and_universes: Source lead: an everywhere-continuous real-valued function on the real line with period 2*pi. Open Lean choices include a real continuous map on AddCircle (2*pi), a periodic real-line function, or a checked complex/arbitrary-positive-period transport, with exact universes and typeclass binders.
conclusion: Open formal target. The inspected source conclusion is uniform convergence to f of the arithmetic means s_0, (s_0+s_1)/2, ..., (s_0+...+s_(n-1))/n.
